            --secret-string "$secret_value" \

### Manual Rotation Script

```javascript
// scripts/rotate-secrets.js
const { SecretsManagerClient, UpdateSecretCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager');
const crypto = require('crypto');

function generateSecureSecret(length = 64) {
  return crypto.randomBytes(length).toString('base64');
}

async function rotateSecret(secretName) {
  const client = new SecretsManagerClient({ region: 'us-east-1' });
  
  // Generate new secret
  const newSecret = generateSecureSecret();
  
  await client.send(new UpdateSecretCommand({
    SecretId: secretName,
    SecretString: JSON.stringify({ value: newSecret }),
  }));
  
  console.log(`Rotated secret: ${secretName}`);
}

// Usage
rotateSecret('production/app/jwt');
```
